title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The improved food and livelihood security programme in Chad implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to address the food security, health and nutrition needs of displaced and host households. The objectives of the programme is to improve the food security of host and IDP communities through support to improved vegetable yields to increase dietary diversity; to support livelihood diversity; and to reduce the prevalence, mortality and morbidity associated with acute malnutrition working with local health centres and households . To promote alternative sources of income and dietary diversity, the programme supports two fishing associations, whose members have received training in administrative and financial management, sustainable fishing techniques, net repair, canoe construction, fish processing (drying, salting and smoking) and the production of organic fertiliser from fish waste. Fishing equipment and IGA kits have been distributed to the associations, and processing and storage facilities have been built.
